771250302.text: Uh... Is it trying to thank us?

771250303.text: Well, we can't understand a single word you're saying, but... you're welcome?

771250305.text: The somewhat big Jack Frost stares blankly for a second, then...\npulls a wooden slate from behind its back and starts scribbling away with its finger.

771250306.text: Wait, what's that...? Whoa! You actually know how to write?!

771250308.text: Let Paimon see... "Thank you, good people. I am the village chief."

771250309.text: Wow, the chief! Well, you're welcome, chief.

771250311.text: But wait, "chief" is what you do, not who you are. What's your actual name?

771250314.text: Ugh, this is getting us nowhere... Let's just stick with "Chief" for now!

771250316.text: So, Chief, what exactly happened around here?

771250318.text: Oh... So they broke into your village and started pushing everyone around?

771250320.text: Well... Yeah, their claws do look a whole lot harder than yours... But what are we supposed to do about that?

771250322.text: Wait, can we really block them with just snowballs?

771250323.text: Only if we stuff some stones inside...

771250324.text: Where do you even come up with such terrifying ideas...

771250326.text: Hey! Don't look at him like you just changed its entire worldview! Putting rocks in snowballs is way too dangerous.

771250327.text: But come to think of it, do snowballs even work? If they did, those volkodlaks wouldn't have broken in here in the first place...

771250329.text: Oh! So you're trying to build some kind of Prime Ice cannon to launch the snowballs, but you guys ran out of time to assemble the mechanisms?

771250331.text: I guess we could pitch in?

771250332.text: Yeah! It's not like we haven't crafted our fair share of weird Prime Ice stuffs before...

771250334.text: "Blond hair, big hero! White hair, soft but hard!"

771250335.text: Hey! "Soft but hard" doesn't sound like a compliment at all!

771250337.text: Paimon thinks it wants us to follow it. Let's go see what's up ahead!

771251003.text: Hmm, well let's see where else we need to place the prime ice mechanisms!

771251005.text: Hmm... You mean the volkodlaks will come from other paths, right? Paimon gets it!

771251006.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's see where else along those paths we can place the prime ice mechanisms!

771251008.text: Got it. Just like before, we'll let you know as soon as we're ready.

771250102.text: Oh dear, you poor little fella... There, there, we already those two big bullies!

771250105.text: Wait, huh? Why are you still looking so down? Could it be because they took your Mora too?

771250107.text: It doesn't look like it has pockets, Paimon.

771250112.text: Still scared of being bullied? But we already ran those volkodlaks off...

771250115.text: Where on earth did you pull that from!

771250118.text: Hey, little guy, are there other friends of yours out there who are still in trouble?

771250120.text: Waving hands like fluffy snowballs, this Jack Frost rattles its tiny tambourine as it tries to explain how its kin back home are being bullied by volkodlaks...

771250121.text: Ugh, those volkodlaks are the worst.

771250122.text: If we ever cross paths with your hometown, we'll make sure to teach them a lesson they won't forget!

771250402.text: So... this is the path where the volkodlaks are coming from?

771250403.text: Combining the fragmented words on its slate with clumsy gestures, the chief tells you of the attacks that have long plagued their home...

771250404.text: So you're saying those bad volkodlaks invade this place just to bully you guys every now and then...

771250405.text: And they just stroll right down that path like they own the place,

771250406.text: taking whatever they want and leaving the whole area in a total mess!

771250407.text: Oh, that's just terrible... Those volkodlaks really are the absolute worst!

771250408.text: I get it now! That's why you want to set up those giant snowball cannons right along this path...

771250409.text: And use the giant snowballs to chase them off!

771250412.text: Alright, alright, we'll help out with the cannons!

771250415.text: Got it, got it. We'll let you know as soon as we're ready!

771251701.text: Ugh, it's not worth it if we keep going like this...

771251702.text: Darn it, I was planning to get my money back this way... Now the money I paid for help has gone up in smoke!

771251703.text: Looks like I'll have to find another way. Hmph! C-Consider yourselves lucky, you Jack Frosts!

771251704.text: That should keep them from ever coming back...

771251705.text: After all, every single path leading in here is already full of prime ice traps and mechanisms.

771251707.text: Hehe! Paimon got it this time! That was definitely their way of saying thanks.

771251710.text: Huh? What is it up to this time...

771251712.text: It's running off again! Let's catch up and check it out.

771252202.text: Oh! Looks like it's finally free.

771252203.text: Still, what are Jack Frosts actually made of anyway? Snow? It was trapped under there for ages, but it didn't even lose its shape...

771251801.text: Wait, it's the chief, and a whole bunch of Jack Frosts. And what's that they're crowding around...

771251803.text: What do you mean, "finally, completely"? Paimon doesn't get it at all.

771251807.text: So you're saying we should... shoot snowballs... at the sign on the door?

771251809.text: Paimon thinks she gets it now. So "hard" means Paimon is awesome, right?

771251810.text: Ah, "finally, completely" means that when we "finally" finish this, the village will "completely" go back to the way it was... right?

771251813.text: Paimon knew you were going to do that sooner or later!

771251816.text: Alright, let's help you fix that sign on the door!

771252102.text: Are you okay? Whoa, you made some really weird noises.

771252104.text: Although you don't look too well yet, it doesn't seem to be anything serious...

771250501.text: Phew, looks like we've finally fixed up everything damaged by the volkodlaks! They really did a number on this place!

771250502.text: At least it's back to the way it was.

771250504.text: Hehe, don't mention it! Seeing your village back to normal makes us super happy too!

771250505.text: But wait... why were those volkodlaks raiding you guys in the first place? From what they was saying, it sounds like there's a ton of valuable stuff hidden around here.

771250508.text: So you have some awesome stuff inside your shop? Whoa, Paimon doesn't know why, but it feels like she can understand you perfectly now, chief!

771250509.text: And wait, Paimon never expected this place to actually be a shop! Is it your shop?

771250511.text: So you're saying those volkodlaks wanted to loot your stuff, but since this is a shop, things are supposed to be traded for?

771250512.text: Oh, so you guys use Mora too?

771250517.text: "Blond hair, white hair, good! Give, give!"

771250518.text: The somewhat big Jack Frost reaches behind its back with both hands, pulling out a handful of clinking objects and placing them into your palms.\nYou instantly recognize them as...

771250519.text: So that's what you meant by "bite-ons"!

771250523.text: Well, that makes sense. Paimon guesses Jack Frosts don't really have any use for Mora anyway...

771250524.text: So, as long as we find more of these "bite-ons" — uh, buttons — we can use them to trade for stuff at your shop? Is that how this works?

771250526.text: Alright! If we find any more of these buttons, we'll definitely bring them straight to you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate the source of the massive ya-ho
Follow the village chief to the entrance
Follow the village chief to the entrance
Help place two assault-type snowball launchers

771250604.text: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.

771250605.text: Just as expected, it isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path.

771250606.text: Alright, now let's see if those prime ice mechanisms are of any use!

subQuests.subQuestName: Hold your ground against the Volkodlak

771250904.text: And so, before the volkodlaks arrive for the second time, you wrap up your preparations alongside the Jack Frosts as you set up the defensive fortifications.

771250905.text: It isn't long before a horde of volkodlaks comes into view at the end of the path. In a way, they're quite persistent...

771250906.text: Hehe! Now every path they take is full of mechanisms!

771251101.text: D—Darn it, since when did these stupid Jack Frosts become such a pain?

771251102.text: J-Just you wait! We're gonna gather the whole pack and roll you up into snowballs!

771251103.text: We did it! These cannons are pretty awesome!

771251105.text: Ah, but we can't let our guard down just yet.

771251106.text: The volkodlaks who just fled said they'd be back with backup...

771251108.text: You weren't listening to a single word they said, were you?

771251113.text: Hey! You never miss a chance to be dramatic, do you?!

771251116.text: But anyway, we won't just sit idly by!

771251119.text: Are you asking us if we want to rest for a while or keep helping with the prep work?

771251115.text: Hmm, if there really were ten times as many, that would be pretty exhausting!

subQuests.subQuestName: Hold your ground against the Volkodlak
Follow the village chief to the village center
Repair the sign using the snowball launcher

771251904.text: Alright, we know what to do now!
